## ✅ Notebook Checklist

*For Jupyter Notebook PRs, please verify:*

- [ ] Notebook runs end-to-end without errors (`Kernel → Restart & Run All`)
- [ ] All outputs cleared before commit (`Kernel → Restart & Clear Output`)
- [ ] Meaningful variable names and inline comments used
- [ ] Markdown cells explain concepts clearly
- [ ] No hardcoded absolute file paths
- [ ] Large files (> 10 MB) are NOT committed — a download link is provided instead
